requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.
requirements.evidence: Cell 0,0 is piece:0,0,0;half-s. Drawer drawer:0#0,0#cut (key n) sits on its north cut face at 0,0,0. Spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 sits at junction [0,0 + 0,1 + 1,0] which is the north-east corner of that same cell. Supports for the spike are piece:0,1,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full around the same junction, so drawer frame and spike base share that corner and touch. Mesh check is clear and locked with 3 jointBolts.

finish.summary: Minimal 3-base build: half-s base at 0,0 hosts a north-facing drawer on its cut, and a spike at the shared triple junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 formed with two full neighbours at 0,1 and 1,0. Both occupy the same corner of the same cell and are adjacent/touching; capped and bolted, meshClash clear.

M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
